Many birds live in the rainforest.
Polar bears live in the Arctic.
My favourite wild animal is|It lives in|It can

text_en: The rainforest is hot and wet.
It is the habitat of many animals.
Colourful parrots fly over the trees.
Monkeys swing from branch to branch.
A sloth sleeps all day in a tall tree, and it moves very slowly.
On the ground, a leopard hunts at night.
It has beautiful spots, so it can hide in the leaves.
Frogs and snakes live near the river.
Some animals in the rainforest are in danger because people cut down the trees.

questions.q: Why are some animals in danger?
